manaNeeded: {1}{W} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
easyPrerequisites: Robe of Stars attached to Hades.
description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Robe of Stars by paying {1}{W}, phasing out Hades.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
During your extra turn, Hades phases in during your untap step.
Repeat.
